Good service, clean and organized place.
Calm consultation with plenty of attention and care.
Very good
Terrible service. I do not recommend it. Never take your beloved pets to places like this.
Excellent service from the initial contact via WhatsApp. Clean clinic, qualified professionals. Best report in the region.

I confirmed an appointment via WhatsApp, but unfortunately, to my surprise, when I arrived with my cat, I was informed that there had been a system error and the appointment was not scheduled. The receptionist didn't even apologize for what happened; I think the least she could have done was apologize, since she saw that I had confirmed the appointment.
The clinic and the doctors are wonderful. Adriana and Carla are incredible people and always willing to help. I can only thank them for everything they have done and continue to do for my pets.
A great veterinary clinic

I took my kitten to the clinic on a recommendation and I have no words to thank them for how they treated him. My kitten wasn't an easy cat to handle, he had a strong personality, and the professionals treated him with so much affection. From the moment he was admitted, he was well cared for; during visits, my kitten always smelled nice, and you could tell he was being cared for. Even though his case was terminal, he was treated with a warm blanket, good food, and oxygen when necessary. My kitten passed away today, and they comforted me, gave us privacy to say goodbye, and in the end, they "prepared" the kitten for us to take him to bury him. I feel compelled to share my experience because I've been to several veterinary clinics and had terrible experiences, such as leaving the animal dirty or stressed. Once again, thank you for everything, from the reception to the doctors! May God always bless your careers, and thank you for providing my kitten with the best possible rest.
Excellent professionals, very caring service for pets.

I received excellent service from the moment I arrived, and the X-ray report was delivered quickly in less than an hour. It was for a delicate case, requiring surgery that same day.

I found a place to have exams done and even consultations with specialists.

Thank you for the excellent service.

I didn't know the clinic and I found it on the recommendation of my dog ​​Willy José's veterinarian, the excellent Dr. Elisabete Cavalcante (Madureira).
I am very grateful to the clinic's team and especially to Dr. Ellen Jaffé, cardiologist, for the exemplary care I received with my little dog, Willy.
Dr. Ellen demonstrated admirable calmness and incredible patience in explaining every detail of the diagnosis to me — it was practically a lesson, with accessible and clear language, which made me understand a complex problem in a calm way. Her demeanor conveyed total security and confidence regarding the treatment, in addition to explaining the prescription meticulously and carefully.
The clinic is extremely clean, organized and welcoming, and the attendants are kind and helpful.
I also want to praise the professional responsible for the X-ray, who treated Willy with patience and gentleness, demonstrating great affection and care during the examination.
I left the clinic with a relieved heart and the certainty that my little one is in excellent hands. We will be back! ❤️🐾

I can only express my gratitude for how well my pet and I were treated at the clinic.

And not only that, but for the care and attention they gave us.

And we know that this goes beyond the professional!

May God bless Diagnosis!
They were very attentive in their care for our pets.
Top

The clinic offers very good service from the professionals who perform the exams. However, the receptionists are extremely unfriendly. They treat you as if they are doing you a favor, as if everything there is free.
Excellent professionals

Terrible service at reception. The place is nice enough for pets, however, there was a glaring error because they sent me ANOTHER DOG'S EXAM RESULTS, not mine. I returned from my trip and went to print them out to see them better, as I had to visit a veterinarian before the trip, and I discovered it was ANOTHER DOG'S EXAM RESULTS, and expensive just for a glucose test, which I thought would be a complete blood test for the price paid.
Excellent service, I've always gone there for emergencies, and I've always been seen the same day, or even immediately. And the X-ray and ultrasound staff are super caring and attentive to patients.
Excellent service!

The veterinary cardiologist who treated my dog ​​is wonderful in her care and friendliness. However, the receptionist is very rude and not at all friendly. She speaks in a bad mood and with a sour face.
Very attentive, careful and loving with pets.
Exceptional service, humanity, and care. I wasn't familiar with the clinic, and my dog ​​received excellent care. Thank you so much to everyone ❤️
Excellent professionals with very good exams.

The place was clean and everything was in order. It was empty, I had an appointment, and everything went smoothly and quickly. It was my first time there, recommended by my son's vet, and I will definitely return if I need anything. They offer various services.
